question: On a video, should Option Delete ripple delete the way it does in Premiere on the Mac?
context: Premiere on the Mac uses Option Delete for Ripple Delete. In Photonz, Option Delete is Photoshop's Fill with Foreground, and on a video clip it does nothing (checked on 2026-10-07 with In and Out marked and with a piece picked). Ripple Delete is on Shift Delete.

options.label: Option Delete ripple deletes on the timeline; Fill keeps it elsewhere
options.summary: With the timeline in use and a clip or a marked stretch picked, Option Delete takes it out and closes the gap, as Shift Delete does. On a title, a shape or a picture it still fills with the foreground colour, as in Photoshop.
pros: A Premiere editor on a Mac gets the key their hands already press
Today the press does nothing at all on a clip, so nothing a person relies on changes
cons: One key does two things depending on what is picked
options.mitigation: It only ripple deletes where Fill has nothing to fill (a clip or a stretch of time), and the menu keeps showing Shift Delete as the one printed key.

options.label: Leave it: Shift Delete only
options.summary: Option Delete stays Fill with Foreground everywhere and does nothing on a clip. Ripple delete stays on Shift Delete, as the menu shows.
cons: A Premiere editor on a Mac presses Option Delete and nothing happens, with no hint why
options.mitigation: The Sequence menu shows Shift Delete beside Ripple Delete.
